text:
tess_sales: AxiomaPay asked for a 4-week evaluation to replace heuristics for routing/support triage. They want success metrics + infra requirements ASAP.
omar_se: Key asks: intent classification (F1 target >= 0.87), embeddings for KB search (top-3 recall > 0.9), near-real-time CRM lookups via tool calls, and strict PII handling. Budget target = $12k cap.
lucy_ml: Data note: they have long call transcripts (up to ~12k tokens) and want structured JSON outputs for routing. They can provide ~250 labeled intents and ~400 relevance labels for embeddings.
raj_eng: They prefer Dedicated or VPC-hosted instance because of compliance. We need to confirm VPC peering + BYOK KMS options. That will affect lead time and pricing.
mika_security: They want audit logs, retention policy options, and an answer on whether we can restrict logs from storing PII. Also asked for SOC2 + encryption spec.
tess_sales: Quick question for ML/infra: do we need 32k context or can we chunk transcripts reliably?
lucy_ml: For 12k I'd recommend using a 16k or 32k-capable model. Chunking works but makes intent aggregation and tool-calling harder. If tool-calling needs full context, prefer a 32k profile.
omar_se: For tool-calling we should enforce strict schema + deterministic fallback. Example rule: if response missing required fields -> return {"action":"manual_review"} and log.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: provisioning checklist created: "vpc-cidr, admin-sa, kms-arn, firewall rules, monitoring hooks"
raj_eng: Hosted vs Dedicated: hosted = no infra setup, pay per token; dedicated = reserved capacity, lower unit costs, and easier VPC integrations. Cache/prefix KV will cut repeated token costs significantly.
lucy_ml: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- Intent F1 >= 0.87 on their labeled set
- Embedding top-3 recall >= 0.9
- Tool-call schema pass rate >= 96%
- p95 latency < 300ms (hosted) or < 180ms (dedicated) for single-turn routing
- Security: encrypted at rest, KMS control if BYOK, audit logs enabled, retention options provided
- Cost: POC spend <= $12k or equivalent Dedicated trial credit
tess_sales: Blockers on their side: legal needs IP wording for prompt tuning, infra needs contact for peering, product wants SLA for fallback behavior.
mika_security: IP stance: customer retains data and outputs; we ask for license to use aggregated telemetry to improve models unless customer opts out. I'll draft the clause. Also propose default log retention 90 days with 30/365 options.
omar_se: For the runbook: week 0: confirm scope + security Q answers; week 1: infra provisioning; week 2: model selection + baseline tests; week 3: evals and iterations; week 4: report + handover.
lucy_ml: Evals plan: run zero-shot, prompt engineering, then a light-shot fine-tune if allowed. We'll evaluate structured output QA using regex/schema checks and rerun failing cases for prompting fixes.
tess_sales: I'll draft a 1-page POC scope & acceptance doc and circulate to AxiomaPay and legal. Anything to add?
lucy_ml: Add a line about fallback routing: if structured output fails schema, route to deterministic rules and capture examples for retraining.
raj_eng: Add expected IPs for peering and a temporary admin rotation process.
mika_security: Request: ask them to mark any ultra-sensitive PII in the eval set so we can redact before storing.
tess_sales: Great. I'll post the draft in #sales tomorrow and follow up with a calendar invite for the infra sync. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
